newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end lower as trade remains nervous.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end lower as trade remains nervous.

text.p: 1510 GMT - Swiss bond prices ended lower, undermined by nervousness as both U.S. and German bonds tended lower. Bonds still seen expensive vs swaps but LIFFE EuroSwiss firmed a bit.
* Conf future ends down 27 basis points at 119.80
* 4-1/2 pct June 2007 bond yields 3.502 pct vs 3.463 pct
